description.narrative: CONSTRUCTION OF A JETTY HANDLING AREA AND STORAGE HOUSING ADDITIONAL AMOUNT WAS APPROVED ID 527000 _ US$ 500000 IN 11/6/1985. THE PROJECT AIMS AT THE EXPANSION OF THE EXISTING PORTFACILI TIES AT MUTSAMUDU ON THE ISLAND OF ANJOUAN AND THE BUILDING OF A DEEP WATER PORT CAPABLE BERTHING LARGE SHIPS.
